pretraining: Full-official original RGBNT100 DeMo50 bestE8 plus additional50/new Adam; original identity encoder fixed

anchor.method: RGBNT100 global AV42 with only spatial FFT cutoffs 0.25/0.375. Existing three-band masks change for both M and F; original global readers, identity teacher42, fresh expert42/Adam, losses, routing, projections, gates, optimizer groups, data order, BN2/partial0/two backwards and descriptor5120 remain. No new learned parameters or failed local-grid reader. Ordinary receives identical cutoffs. Full8675train/1715query/8575gallery, extra50, earliest normal benchmarkmAP-best/all six same checkpoint. Known parameter tuning, not a new module, energy-balance claim or established retrieval gain.
anchor.limits: Fixed teacher42 conditional expert repeats, not five end-to-end pipelines. This constructor alone does not install AV or BC training policies; the separately reviewed selected recipe must do so. No missing training, calibrated-utility, retrieval-gain or complete-runtime claim.

final_unit_descriptor_bound.placement: After complete parent M/F/I aggregation, gates and relation weights; before final deployed return
final_unit_descriptor_bound.inactive_output: Exact original candidate bytes; 00 remains the existing frozen identity path
final_unit_descriptor_bound.limits: Known norm bound; not retrieval correctness or guaranteed +1. K PI10/01 native equality is checked before this new output bound.

anchor.contribution_reference: Stopped-gradient corresponding gallery state; fixed00 positive/negative indices

M_F_auxiliary_outlet.current: Actual first11 projected per-relation unit directions, existing-score relation pool512
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.auxiliary_dtype: FP32 deployed directions; previous raw pools under native AMP
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.metric_outlet: AG softTriplet on actual first11 per512 units flattened+whole-normalized3584; scored512 CE unchanged
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.pooling_domain: Existing M/F pool_score reused over seven projected relation directions, previously raw bands/source-band evidence; no new score parameters/calls
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.inference: Hooks/pool replacement inactive in eval; original5120 graph

F_auxiliary_scorer_precision.scope: Actual second projected F relation scoring only
F_auxiliary_scorer_precision.unchanged_calls: All 4D independent/raw/controlled01 scoring uses the original method
F_auxiliary_scorer_precision.evidence: W ordinary native3 nnz0/3/0 versus sameZ/weight/scaledfull upstream FP32 localVJP512/512/512; original native failure retained, new pair native required

M_auxiliary_scorer_precision.scope: Actual second projected M relation scoring only
M_auxiliary_scorer_precision.unchanged_calls: All 4D independent/raw/controlled10 scoring uses the original method
M_auxiliary_scorer_precision.evidence: Source-reviewed AC ordinary replay measured three actual updates: steps1/3 Mscore grad present finite allzero, step2 nonzero53; same actual Z/weight/upstream local FP32 VJP nonzero512. Gradients remain extremely small; supports precision sensitivity, not a proved individual underflow instruction or retrieval gain. Candidate numerical repair needs fresh matched random/hard native3 pervariant; no gate relaxation.

anchor.routing_change: All existing joint a_S+c_b+psi logits divided by2 before legal-relation masking and softmax. All other routing, conditioning, projections, gates, losses and frozen encoder behavior retain AG.
anchor.attention_decay_limit: Packed QKV includes V. Remaining decay/LR/model/loss and source/band access are unchanged; no QK-exclusive causal claim.
anchor.modality_query_limit: Only M spatial projected Q amplitude removed. K/V/F/crossband unchanged. Not the full QKNorm method or an established identity-relevance mechanism.
anchor.frequency_value_decay_limit: Only two middle/high input Linear weights; low band and every other AS policy retained. Not a new identity mechanism or established cause.
anchor.seed_scope: One fixed teacher42; conditional expert-stage seed only, not a whole-pipeline repeat
anchor.construction_scope: Original global AV42 fresh-expert construction; only existing persistent band-mask values changed

checkpoint_rule: Maximum full official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs; ties keep earliest epoch
evaluation_scope: Entire official training split and entire official query/gallery; no fit/dev holdout
selection_limitation: Official benchmark is used for checkpoint selection; this is not an untouched independent final test
method_revision: RGBNT100 global AV42 with only spatial FFT cutoffs 0.25/0.375. Existing three-band masks change for both M and F; original global readers, identity teacher42, fresh expert42/Adam, losses, routing, projections, gates, optimizer groups, data order, BN2/partial0/two backwards and descriptor5120 remain. No new learned parameters or failed local-grid reader. Ordinary receives identical cutoffs. Full8675train/1715query/8575gallery, extra50, earliest normal benchmarkmAP-best/all six same checkpoint. Known parameter tuning, not a new module, energy-balance claim or established retrieval gain.
partial_training: Unchanged global AV42 BN2/partial0/two backwards; no missing-specialist training.
amp_policy: Native fp16 GradScaler512; actual optimizer updates and skipped steps recorded
retention: Only best.pth; smoke strict reload in memory; no initial, last, or smoke weight files
